name: Researcher

sections.daily_work: Design and conduct studies, experiments, or surveys. Analyze data and write reports. Review literature. Present findings. Apply for grants and funding.
sections.learning: Research methodology, statistics, academic writing, literature review, data analysis tools (SPSS, R, Python), domain expertise in your field of study.
sections.pay: Research assistants start around $35,000-$50,000 USD. Full researchers with advanced degrees earn $60,000-$120,000+. University professors vary widely. Verify for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Bachelor's degree in a field of interest, research assistant positions, graduate school (master's or PhD), publishing papers, networking at academic conferences.

try_in_real_life: Read a research paper on a topic you love (try Google Scholar)
Design a simple survey using Google Forms and analyze results
Find a professor or lab doing interesting work and ask about volunteering
Write a short literature review on a topic that fascinates you
sources: National Science Foundation surveys; academic career outlook reports
